title: Boundary metrics measure boundary-count equality, not boundary positions

evidence.note: Boundary precision/recall/F1/displacement use only boundary_count vs expected_boundaries.
expected_boundaries itself is a declared counter, not compared coordinates.

remediation.objective: Separate count agreement from positional boundary quality and enforce real boundary matching. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Rename existing count ratios to count_agreement and the absolute difference to count_difference.
Add positional boundary matching with a documented distance tolerance on canonical ordinal/page coordinates.
Report positional precision/recall/F1 plus true displacement on matched pairs only.
Require unmatched predictions as false positives and unmatched reviewed boundaries as false negatives.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary metric names no longer claim positional quality they do not measure.
A permuted-boundary negative fixture fails the positional metric while count agreement stays 1.
Boundary displacement is zero only for matched boundaries, never for equal counts.

verification.expected: Permuted boundaries fail positional precision; count agreement stays 1.
DATA rule asserts positional boundary contract and fixtures.

assessment.note: Verified in current source: JSON output shows boundary_precision=min(count,expected)/count and displacement=abs(count-expected). Owner mapping is intentionally unassigned until main supplies authoritative GSD ownership.
